rationale: Stiven's ArNav platform combines computer vision and ML to deliver real-time surgical guidance—exactly the kind of production-ready AI application in healthtech that TheAgentic.Ai builds infrastructure for. Sharon's focus on agentic AI systems for biotech and healthtech sectors could be valuable as Stiven scales the technical team and prepares for FDA processes.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Sharon — she builds AI agent infrastructure for healthtech at TheAgentic.Ai and may be a useful technical sounding board as you grow the engineering team at Braillic.
